preToolUse.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/copilot-godkann.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f"; exit 0

sessionStart.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/agentpuls.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f" lag --harness copilot >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

postToolUse.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/agentpuls.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f" aktivitet --harness copilot >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

postToolUseFailure.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/agentpuls.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f" aktivitet --harness copilot >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

subagentStart.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/agentpuls.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f" aktivitet start --harness copilot >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

subagentStop.bash: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; f="$r/tools/agentpuls.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] && bash "$f" aktivitet done --harness copilot >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
